$comment: Node-side build tooling: vite.config.ts. Kept separate from the browser program in
tsconfig.json because it is executed by Node, not shipped to the browser, and it needs
both Vite's own types and Node's globals (__dirname, process, path). Putting it in the
DOM project forced that project to depend on 'vite/client' types, which is what made
type-checking fail with TS2688 on a build where vite was not resolvable.
